newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio, Inmet up Antamina estimate.
newsitem.headline: Rio, Inmet up Antamina estimate.

text.p: Rio Algom Ltd and Inmet Mining Corp said on Thursday that they increased their estimate at their Antamina copper, zinc, silver and molybdenum deposit in Peru to more than 500 million tonnes.

The two mining companies said in a statement that assay results from the first 140 holes representing 48,000 metres of drilling indicated a total in-pit resource of at least 500 million tonnes averaging 1.2 percent copper, 1.0 percent zinc, 11 grams per tonne of silver 0.03 percent molybdenum.
They said the deposit was expected to last for 20 years at the anticipated production rate of 70,000 tonnes of ore a day.
Rio and Inmet said its assaying program would continue for the next several months until a total of 100,000 metres was drilled.
